label: 2025 land, population and yields
description: Layer 3: adds crop yields from the ABS data of 2022-23 to 2024-25 (three years). Twelve field crops, avocados, bananas and macadamias are measured (SA2 area and production given to the 2011 zones); every other crop and the derived rows move by the group trend of their group (SCOPE.md B10); animal products, honey, wild fish and timber are carried from 2011 until the livestock layer. Diets and other defaults stay at 2011.

yieldMatrix.what: g/m2 for every injected row of the Yield sheet, one line per zone; data/2025/yield_provenance.csv says how each cell was made

errata: Animal products, honey, wild fish and timber are the 2011 yields.
Vegetables, fruit and nuts have no area after 2020-21; their change is the group factor carried from 2016-21 (pipeline/yields/recent/README.md).
